methodology.name: The packet is the contract
methodology.rule: Every rule, accepted value and row shape a gate enforces is printed where the model acts: in the duty, the template or Checked by, generated from the same table or function the gate reads (allowed_consumers, _stage_gates, the validators), so the text cannot drift from the gate. A model that needs ShipLoop's source to learn what complete accepts is a packet defect, not a model defect.
methodology.tested_by: A render test pins the printed values to the gate's own table, and a route test builds a result only from the printed template or example row and submits it through the real `complete --check-only`. Live: reads of skills/shiploop/scripts/*.py per stage (E2E counters) fall towards 0.
owner_rules: main tenet: context is cleared between stages, each packet works alone
test the route, not the wording

methodology.name: The script owns it
methodology.rule: What the script can know or compute (tree identity, reuse of a passed run, routing after a revise, which paths to commit, whether a command reads the tree) the script decides, records and prints; what it can check it refuses, and every refusal names its way out (the revise or blocked route). The model never re-derives state or decides to skip a check.
methodology.tested_by: A route test through the real CLI (fail-first with the source reverted), and each guard proven against a mutant of the new code (the U9 pattern: one-byte edit, changed command list).
owner_rules: scripts own graph position and state; the model does one step and reports done
test skip is fail-safe (skip only on script-proven 'nothing to test')
test the route, not the wording

methodology.name: By value, once
methodology.rule: Content the step acts on is printed by value at its point of use (the selected card section, ## Commands, the revise summary), each fact in one home and printed once per packet; everything else is a locator. Low-value repeats are removed rather than trimmed.
methodology.tested_by: render_diff's head table (every stage at or under 20,000 printed characters) and a test that a repeated fact (an open item, a summary) appears once; live: file reads right after a print.
owner_rules: compact packets printed whole
reference, do not reprint unchanged long text

methodology.name: One step's context only
methodology.rule: A packet carries what this step needs: duties that cannot apply (an empty checkout, no service) shrink to a one-line trigger, and every pointer is precise enough to open only its section (heading plus line range).
methodology.tested_by: Render a fixture where the duty does not apply and assert the one-line trigger replaces it; for every pointer, a test opens the printed line range and finds the named heading on its first line.
owner_rules: KISS
compact packets printed whole
open only the section a step needs

methodology.name: Evidence is a script-run command with visible output
methodology.rule: A claim (a criterion, a platform behaviour, a reviewer's classification, a person procedure, a release confirm) is backed by a command that ran against the tree or target under test and whose output is saved; a check that reads the implementation's own text, or a run that cannot see the candidate, is not evidence.
methodology.tested_by: A fixture whose only evidence is text (a literal grep Proof, a command that ignores the tree) is refused or flagged; live: mutants killed, Proofs that execute behaviour, probes saved under RUN.
owner_rules: test pass is the evidence (progress = a script-run test that passed)
ShipLoop enterprise rigour

methodology.name: Platform knowledge lives in the platform card, linked where decided
methodology.rule: Runner reporters, deploy-before-test, tool-state paths and access probes are written once in references/platforms/<platform>.md (machine-readable parts declared there too) and linked by section at the stages that decide them (test-strategy, plan, step-plan, prepare); scripts stay generic and the card never contradicts the code.
methodology.tested_by: A render test that a run whose target is platform X prints GUIDES/platforms/X.md#<section> at those stages; a card-versus-code test (the card's claim about a reporter or path class matches shiploop_test_counts / item_scope); a grep test that scripts name no platform outside the card loader.
owner_rules: generic fixes only; platform detail only in references/platforms/

methodology.name: Every file has one writer and named consumers
methodology.rule: Each output (a committed path, an open item, a HOME section, loop state) has one stage or script that writes it and names who reads it, when and in what form; tool state with no decision is listed, not silently committed; a person's item carries the entry and a yes/no form the person can answer.
methodology.tested_by: A route test that an output without its writer or consumer is refused or left uncommitted (untracked tool state is not committed by plan-return; a person-owned item without an entry line is refused) and that report.html shows the consumer's form.
owner_rules: produce for a consumer (every output names its consumer, when it reads it, in what form)

methodology.name: Recovery state is printed, not searched
methodology.rule: Whatever a model needs after a compaction, revise or reboot (its own previous result, the recorded passes, the next command, whether a narrative was shown) is printed by the script in the text the model reads first, computed from run records.
methodology.tested_by: A compaction or revise fixture: render after the recorded state and assert the line names it and the one next command; live: file reads after each compaction.
owner_rules: main tenet: context is cleared between stages
stateless skill: scripts own the last in-progress item, the model reports done

methodology.name: One wording per rule; contradictions are fixed at the home
methodology.rule: A rule has one wording in one constant, imported wherever it prints (the PROCEDURE_WALK pattern); when two texts disagree (authority versus focus, card versus parser, docstring versus route, narrative versus status), the home is fixed and every copy follows. Permissions are stated positively: what may run, under which grant.
methodology.tested_by: A test that every surface imports the one constant, and a card or docstring sentence asserted against the code behaviour it describes.
owner_rules: one supported version (no second wording kept for compatibility)
KISS
prompts: concise, meaningful change

methodology.name: Decide early, prove late
methodology.rule: Each SDLC concern (UI, API, state, migration before and after, switchover, concurrency, security, accessibility, operations) is decided as data at the earliest stage that owns it, carried by ID to the steps and checks that prove it, and reviewed for coverage; a gate checks structure only, Improve judges substance.
methodology.tested_by: A structure gate route test (a missing concern row or an unmapped yes row is refused; a docs-only item with every row `no` and a reason passes) and a live stateful case whose rows each name a decision and a check.
owner_rules: example apps are SDLC examples: judge by SDLC fidelity
ShipLoop enterprise rigour
